newsitem.title: USA: Campbell Soup's Dorrance sells 4.1 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Soup's Dorrance sells 4.1 mln shrs.

text.p: John Dorrance, heir to Campbell Soup Co fortune said Monday he sold 4,129,275 common shares in the company lowering his stake to 19,275,981 common shares or 7.8 percent of the outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dorrance, who retired from Campbell's board in 1995, said he sold the stock since September 23 at prices ranging from $77.75 to $78.625 per share in open market or in private sales.
Dorrance, a citizen of Ireland, previously held 23,405,246 common shares or 9.5 percent of the outstanding stock.
In the filing, Dorrance said he intends to sell more shares "as opportunties become available" and when "economically advantageous." "Such future dispositions may be substantial."
Dorrance said in the filing he has disposed of a total 17.6 percent of his holdings in open market or in private transactions.
As of 1350 ET/1750 GMT, Campbell Soup Co was trading on the New York Stock Exchange at 77-3/4.
